subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Cause-Effect Graphing
description: A quick, practical guide to Cause-Effect Graphing.

hook.text: If condition A AND condition B, then action X. If condition A OR condition C, then action Y. Map the logic.

buildup.text: Cause-effect graphing maps input conditions (causes) to output actions (effects) using Boolean logic.

discovery.text: The graph is then converted to a decision table, which directly generates test cases for every logical path.

twist.text: Complex specifications produce complex graphs. The technique is powerful but can be time-consuming to apply.

climax.text: It excels for business rules with many interacting conditions—insurance, banking, and eligibility logic.

punchline.text: Map causes to effects. Logic becomes test cases.

quiz.question: What does cause-effect graphing map?
options: Input conditions to output actions using Boolean logic
